text:
sam_customer: Hi team — for our POC next week the security team asked for a short bundle: an ISO27001 scope excerpt, a KMS separation diagram showing customer vs. platform keys, and a signed pen-test attestation letter. Can you confirm what we can provide and timing?

maria_sales: Thanks Sam — we can provide ISO excerpt + pen-test attestation. KMS diagram needs a quick diagram from infra. Lee, can we pull that?

lee_se: I can draft the diagram. quick q: do they need HSM-level details or high-level key flow?

sam_customer: High-level is fine. They just want to see customer key isolation and where we store control plane secrets.

devon_sec: We have a standard pen-test attestation template we can sign for customers who complete our NDA. I'll attach the signed PDF once legal okays. ETA ~24 hours.

maria_sales: NDA is already executed. Sam I’ll send you the attestation once legal_bot gives thumbs up.

rachel_compliance: ISO excerpt — we have the scope page that lists controls in-scope for Hosted vs. Dedicated. I can extract the relevant pages and strip internal-only sections. ETA end of day today.

ops_oncall: For KMS separation: platform keys (for infra) are in our KMS path: /redwood/platform/*; customer-managed keys are separate: /redwood/customers/<tenant-id>/*. For the diagram I'll show the KMS boundaries + where backups are encrypted.

lee_se: dropping a quick ASCII sketch for feedback:
```
Customer App -> (TLS) -> Redwood Gateway -> Backend (model infer)
                        |                        |
                 Customer KMS (CMK)          Platform KMS (CMK)
                        |                        |
                   Encrypted KV store        Encrypted logs/metrics
```

lee_se: I'll turn that into a PNG and add the annotations about HSM usage and access controls.

maria_sales: Pricing note — customer asked if Dedicated/environment isolation changes pricing for POC. Sam, we billed them standard POC rate but if they require dedicated capacity that will bump to reserved pricing. We should get a quick quote if they insist on isolated GPUs.

sam_customer: They do want isolation for the POC — can you send a ballpark?

maria_sales: Ballpark for a small dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) for a week = approx $6k-$8k. Will confirm with finance for exact commit terms.

rachel_compliance: One more ask from their auditors: a redacted extract of our ISO evidence for control A.8 (asset management) and A.10 (cryptography). I will prepare a 2-page extract that references the cert and control mapping.

devon_sec: Legal bot — @legal_bot any issues signing the attestation for this customer? NDA done.

legal_bot: automated: Please attach customer name and scope. Non-disclosure confirmed. Manual review by legal assigned to @maria_sales. Expect sign-off in 8 business hours.

maria_sales: Thanks legal_bot. I'll follow up with a short scope email to speed it up. Sam — can you confirm customer tenant-id and contact for signature?

sam_customer: tenant-id = cloudseg-prod-45, contact = emma@cloudseg.com. I'll loop Emma in after we have the artifacts.

ops_oncall: Putting diagram + KMS notes in internal share: https://redwood.internal/docs/poc/cloudseg-kms-diagram (private link). I’ll also add the S3 path to the ISO extract: s3://redwood-compliance/extracts/cloudseg/iso-excerpt.pdf

lee_se: Uploading PNG to the same path now.

rachel_compliance: ISO excerpt and control snippet uploaded. Devon — pen-test attestation draft in /legal/drafts/cloudseg-pen-attest.docx.

devon_sec: I'll mark the attestation as ready and request signature.

maria_sales: Great — plan: deliver ISO excerpt + KMS diagram + pen-test attestation to CloudSeg today, include pricing ballpark and note that dedicated GPUs require a reserved commit. Sam, want me to include a one-line SOW for POC isolation?

sam_customer: Yes please. Also include how long setup takes (ops_oncall).

ops_oncall: Setup for a 2x A100 equiv pool + VPC peering ~ 48-72 hours once we have network CIDRs and peering approvals. Documented here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-provisioning

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll assemble the bundle and send to Emma by EOD. If legal signs earlier we'll attach signed attestation. :thumbsup:

sam_customer: Thanks everyone — much appreciated.

lee_se: If they need an on-prem diagram later we can expand.

rachel_compliance: Closing loop: I'll ping again once the signed attestation is in.

maria_sales: Closing the thread after send. :white_check_mark:
